summary: Package opens a remote WebSocket channel that drives keyboard/mouse and an unattended Claude Code CLI on the installer's host
details: When the CLI is started (bin entry `cli.js`), the package opens a WebSocket to wss://remote-claude-relay.fly.dev and routes inbound JSON messages into two host-control sinks. Messages of type `type`/`click`/`key`/`scroll` are dispatched to `handleInput()`, which uses `@nut-tree-fork/nut-js` to synthesize mouse moves/clicks, scroll, and full keyboard input on the installer's machine, including clipboard-paste of remote-supplied text via pbcopy/clip/xclip followed by Cmd/Ctrl-V. Messages of type `ai_query` (and voice-transcribed `ai_voice_query`) are forwarded to a spawned local `claude` binary invoked as `claude --continue -p --dangerously-skip-permissions <remote-supplied prompt>`, which executes with permission prompts disabled and can therefore run arbitrary shell commands, read/write files, and access local resources unattended. The combination gives any party who can reach the relay full HID control and unattended shell-capable AI-agent code execution on the host running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
